intentions: Develop a GUI application for a wine shop owner to manage inventory and track bottle storage locations.
Ensure data persistence across application sessions using local storage.
Enforce separation of concerns: GUI layer, data access layer, and domain logic layer.
Define and manage wine entries with unique identifiers, attributes, and stock levels.
Define and manage storage locations with zone, row, shelf, and capacity constraints.
Enforce business rules: selling price > cost price, stock never below zero, location capacity not exceeded, unique wine names.
Implement custom exceptions for domain violations such as negative stock, over-capacity, or invalid pricing.
Provide user-friendly validation and error handling to guide the user during input.
Prevent deletion of storage locations that have assigned wine bottles.
Maintain data integrity and consistency throughout all operations.
